title: Canonical shifts for the whole-system realization functors
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a scheme X. The whole-system total inverse limit [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site] carries the composite shift of exact scalar restriction and the right-derived inverse limit. For a supplied reduction calculus S [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], give its reduction the left-adjoint mate of this limit shift through its actual adjunction. For f : X $\to$ Y give whole-system pullback [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems] the exact termwise derived shift. For a finite coefficient inclusion E $\to$ L give whole-system scalar extension the shift characterized by commutation with the universal cochain counit of its specified model [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. These choices are made independently of the completed-operation realization isomorphisms. The scalar counit is universal in the right Kan extension sense [lem-pur-right-kan-extension-coherent-shift].
